hyphen.description: Dash variants become "-", the soft hyphen disappears, and a hyphen that ends a line joins the two halves of the word (infer-\nence -> inference).

ligature.description: Typographic ligatures are spelled out (U+FB01 -> fi).

quotes.description: Curly and low quotes, primes and backticks become straight quotes.

whitespace.description: Every run of whitespace (newline, form feed, no-break space) is one space.

sentence_case.description: The first letter of a sentence is lower-cased on both sides, and a quote piece may start with either case, so a quote that capitalizes a mid-sentence start still matches.

line_join_space.description: A space lost where the extraction joined two lines is restored by ignoring spaces on both sides (inferencesystem <-> inference system).
